timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,550–1,560 KRW per USD

WHY: The news reports the won is trading at historically weak levels (1,550–1,560 KRW/USD), meaning you need significantly more Korean won to purchase each US dollar. Despite strong Korean exports and stock market performance, the won continues to weaken rather than strengthen, making dollar conversions more expensive right now.

TIP: Consider setting up automatic monthly conversions at a fixed rate or waiting for won strength if possible, since timing a single $2,000 purchase monthly leaves you exposed to these unfavorable levels.
